mapper.select: SELECT id, symbol, name, exchange, type, active,listed_at,delisted_at FROM instrument WHERE symbol LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.id, b.instrument_id, b.trade_date, b.open, b.high, b.low, b.close, b.volume, b.amount, b.source, b.fetched_at, b.batch_id, b.is_synthetic, b.created_at, b.updated_at, f.factor FROM daily_bar b JOIN instrument i ON i.id=b.instrument_id LEFT JOIN adjustment_factor f ON f.instrument_id=b.instrument_id AND f.trade_date=b.trade_date AND f.source=b.source AND f.is_synthetic=b.is_synthetic WHERE i.symbol=#{symbol} AND b.is_synthetic=#{synthetic} AND b.source=#{source} AND b.trade_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY b.trade_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_bar(instrument_id, trade_date, open, high, low, close, volume, amount, source, fetched_at, batch_id, is_synthetic) VALUES(#{instrumentId}, #{tradeDate}, #{open}, #{high}, #{low}, #{close}, #{volume}, #{amount}, #{source}, #{fetchedAt}, #{batchId}, #{synthetic}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE open= VALUES(open), high= VALUES(high), low= VALUES(low), close= VALUES(close), volume= VALUES(volume), amount= VALUES(amount), source= VALUES(source), fetched_at= VALUES(fetched_at), batch_id= VALUES(batch_id), is_synthetic= VALUES(is_synthetic)

INSERT INTO adjustment_factor(instrument_id, trade_date, factor, source, is_synthetic) VALUES(#{instrumentId}, #{tradeDate}, #{factor}, #{source}, #{synthetic}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE factor= VALUES(factor), source= VALUES(source)
INSERT INTO daily_bar_audit(instrument_id, trade_date, batch_id, old_value, new_value) VALUES(#{instrumentId}, #{tradeDate}, #{batchId}, #{oldValue}, #{newValue})

INSERT INTO trading_calendar(trade_date, exchange, is_open, is_synthetic, source) VALUES(#{tradeDate}, 'SSE', #{open}, #{synthetic}, #{source}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_open= VALUES(is_open), is_synthetic= VALUES(is_synthetic), source= VALUES(source)
mapper.select: SELECT is_open FROM trading_calendar WHERE trade_date=#{date} AND exchange='SSE' AND is_synthetic=#{synthetic} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT i.symbol, b.source, b.trade_date, b.fetched_at, b.batch_id FROM instrument i JOIN daily_bar b ON b.id=( SELECT x.id FROM daily_bar x WHERE x.instrument_id=i.id AND x.is_synthetic=#{synthetic} ORDER BY x.trade_date DESC, x.fetched_at DESC, x.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY i.symbol
SELECT listed_at FROM instrument WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO instrument_day_status VALUES(#{instrumentId}, #{tradeDate}, #{source}, #{synthetic}, 'SUSPENDED', #{batchId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE batch_id= VALUES(batch_id), status= VALUES(status)

INSERT INTO market_data_revision(instrument_id, trade_date, source, is_synthetic, batch_id, fetched_at, content_hash, bar_json, recorded_at, algorithm_version) VALUES(#{instrumentId}, #{tradeDate}, #{source}, #{synthetic}, #{batchId}, #{fetchedAt}, #{contentHash}, #{newValue}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), 'RAW_V2')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM instrument WHERE symbol LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%')

SELECT r.id, r.bar_json, r.recorded_at FROM market_data_revision r JOIN instrument i ON i.id=r.instrument_id WHERE i.symbol=#{symbol} AND r.source=#{source} AND r.is_synthetic=#{synthetic} AND r.trade_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND r.algorithm_version='RAW_V2' AND r.recorded_at < DATE_ADD(r.trade_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND r.fetched_at < DATE_ADD(r.trade_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM market_data_revision n WHERE n.instrument_id=r.instrument_id AND n.trade_date=r.trade_date AND n.source=r.source AND n.is_synthetic=r.is_synthetic AND n.algorithm_version='RAW_V2' AND n.recorded_at < DATE_ADD(n.trade_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND n.fetched_at < DATE_ADD(n.trade_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND (n.recorded_at > r.recorded_at OR (n.recorded_at=r.recorded_at AND n.id > r.id)) ) ORDER BY r.trade_date

SELECT c.id, c.trade_date, c.is_open AS `open`, c.source, c.updated_at FROM trading_calendar c WHERE c.trade_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND c.exchange='SSE' AND c.is_synthetic=0 AND c.updated_at < DATE_ADD(c.trade_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trading_calendar n WHERE n.trade_date=c.trade_date AND n.exchange=c.exchange AND n.is_synthetic=c.is_synthetic AND n.updated_at < DATE_ADD(n.trade_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND (n.updated_at > c.updated_at OR (n.updated_at=c.updated_at AND n.id > c.id))) ORDER BY c.trade_date

SELECT id,trade_date,is_open AS `open`,source,updated_at FROM ( SELECT c.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY trade_date ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id DESC) AS rank_no FROM trading_calendar c WHERE trade_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND exchange='SSE' AND is_synthetic=0 ) ranked WHERE rank_no=1 ORDER BY trade_date
